The first 8 positive odd integers are:

\[

\]

Their inverses modulo \(16\) are:

\[
\begin{aligned}
1^{-1} &\equiv 1 \pmod{16}\\
3^{-1} &\equiv 11 \pmod{16}\\

7^{-1} &\equiv 7 \pmod{16}\\
9^{-1} &\equiv 9 \pmod{16}\\

15^{-1} &\equiv 15 \pmod{16}
\end{aligned}
\]

Now sum them:

\[
1+11+13+7+9+3+5+15=64
\]

\[
64 \equiv 0 \pmod{16}
\]
